d:
On a rainy day in Gokuldham Society, courier letters are delivered simultaneously to all residents. When Bhide, Popatlal, and Dr. Hathi open theirs, panic spreads across the compound, leading to urgent phone calls pulling Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Sodhi, and Iyer back from their workplaces.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
